fields.publicNote: Land border port of entry linking Calexico (California) and Mexicali (Baja California), documented as the point of Kaper and Eleonora's 1935 permanent-residence entry into the United States. The coordinates mark the historic downtown crossing at the foot of Heffernan Avenue, where the 1933 inspection station stood in 1935; the vehicle crossing was moved two blocks west in 1974 and the present buildings are later.

PL044.reason: Add Montpellier as the documented open-air festival performance site of the Jurmann–Kaper song “Ninon, quand tu me souris” on 22 June 1934 (event TE0031), previously unmapped.

fields.publicNote: Southern French city where a jazz orchestra performed the Jurmann–Kaper song “Ninon, quand tu me souris” (from Tout pour l'amour) on an open-air stage at a summer festival on 22 June 1934, documenting the song's move into the French concert/festival repertoire beyond cinema.

fields.description: Portrait photograph of Andrzej Włast (Gustaw Baumritter), poet and lyricist, one of interwar Warsaw's most prolific revue and cabaret song authors and an early collaborator of Bronisław Kaper.
